title.zh: 将马尼拉Tondo教堂前的Leon十三世广场正式更名为当地的Ka Amado Hernandez广场的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Plaza Leon XIII (Trece) in Front of Tondo Church, Manila, to Ka Amado Hernandez
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Plaza Leon XIII (Trece) in Front of Tondo Church, Manila, to Ka Amado Hernandez

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6164_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Plaza Leon XIII (Trece) situated in front of Tondo Church, Manila, is hereby changed to Ka Amado Hernandez.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
